author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices have witnessed a decline due to lowered global demand forecasts and a notable increase in US inventories. Both Opec and the IEA have adjusted their oil demand growth projections downward for the near future. Ongoing tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb Strait are amplifying supply concerns, while negotiations between Iran and the US remain inconclusive.
title: Oil prices slip as Opec cuts demand forecast; Iran war keeps supply risks alive

author: HINDOL BASU
description: Sri Lankan captain Dhananjaya de Silva expects a spin-focused Test series against India.  He believes the Galle pitch will gradually favor spinners after initial batting conditions.  De Silva highlighted the importance of player temperament for scoring runs on aging wickets.  He noted Prabath Jayasuriya's strong record at Galle as a key advantage.  India's absence of Jasprit Bumrah is considered a significant loss for them.
title: 'We have the upper hand': Sri Lanka captain warns India ahead of Galle Test

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a landmark decision, the US government has taken a significant stake in Intel, officially becoming its largest shareholder. This strategic development signals a pivotal change in the nation's approach to industrial policy and technology strategy. Aiming to enhance domestic manufacturing and protect vital infrastructure, the move offers a sense of supply chain security, but it raises valid concerns regarding potential political interference.
title: It's one year to Intel becoming a 'US govt company', what this meant for the chip giant

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Buffalo Bills’ co-owner Kim Pegula made her first public appearance in more than two years at the team’s new Highmark Stadium. Pegula, who suffered cardiac arrest and a brain injury in 2022, walked onto the field with husband Terry and son Matthew. Her return was especially meaningful because she helped plan the $2.2 billion stadium before her health crisis. The emotional appearance marked a significant moment for her family and the Bills.
title: Kim Pegula makes emotional return to Bills stadium after cardiac arrest

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Thalapathy Vijay's film 'Jana Nayagan' maintained its steady theatrical run on Wednesday. The movie recorded Rs 65 lakhs in India net collection on its twenty-first day. Its overall India net collection has now reached Rs 194.35 crore. Worldwide gross collections for the film stand at Rs 319.57 crore. The H Vinoth directorial continues to perform well in its third week.
title: Jana Nayagan BO Day 21: Vijay film holds at Rs 65L, net reaches Rs 194.35 cr

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Louisiana’s Upper Barataria Marsh Creation Project has restored 1,170 acres of new wetland habitat in the Barataria Basin. One year after construction, white and brown shrimp, blue crab and red drum are using the restored marsh and water features. The project aims to rebuild coastal ecosystems damaged by decades of land loss and the Deepwater Horizon oil spill.
title: Louisiana restores 1,170 acres in Barataria Basin; shrimp and crabs return after a year

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Kuldeep Yadav has played 18 Tests for India and taken 79 wickets in 34 innings. He has a bowling average of 22.35, an economy rate of 3.53 and a strike rate of 37.9. He has taken four four-wicket hauls and five five-wicket hauls. His best innings figures are 5/40, while his best match figures are 8/113. Kuldeep has also been a successful limited-overs bowler. He has 194 wickets from 121 ODIs at an average of 27.04. In 54 T20Is, he has taken 95 wickets at an average of 13.74.
title: 'Very, very difficult': Can Kuldeep Yadav become India's next spin leader?

author: TNN
description: A woman died after falling from a two-wheeler onto a damaged road.  She was then run over by an oncoming mini goods vehicle.  The accident occurred when the two-wheeler skidded after the car ahead braked suddenly.  Residents blamed the poor road condition and civic neglect for the tragic incident.  Police are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the fleeing vehicle and its driver.
title: Broken road, fatal fall: Mom of 3-year-old run over in Bengaluru

author: DEEPU VARGHESE
description: Residents held a candlelight march protesting civic negligence. They blamed the Chandapura municipal council for a fatal accident. Medha Akarsh, a central government employee, died after falling from a two-wheeler. Protesters demanded accountability from civic authorities for the preventable tragedy. The municipal council promised an urgent meeting with officials and contractors.
title: Bengaluru mom’s death sparks fury, civic body faces heat over poor roads
